title: Sum of Digits
prompt: Write a recursive function sumDigits(n) that takes a non-negative integer n and returns the sum of its digits.
commonBug: Missing base case for n === 0 causing maximum call stack size exceeded

title: Binary Search
prompt: Write a function binarySearch(nums, target) that returns the index of target in sorted array nums, or -1 if not found.
commonBug: Off-by-one error using left < right instead of left <= right or wrong mid index update

title: Valid Palindrome
prompt: Write a function isPalindrome(s) that returns true if the string is a palindrome considering alphanumeric characters only and ignoring cases.

input: A man, a plan, a canal: Panama

commonBug: Not filtering non-alphanumeric characters or failing on empty strings

title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
prompt: Given a binary tree node object { val, left, right }, return its maximum depth. An empty tree has depth 0.
